title: Storage of Bile From Routine Procedures to Study Risk Factors
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to establish a repository of human bile as a resource for studies evaluating molecular predictors of biliary cancer risk.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Presenting to IU for treatment of biliary tract disease; Age greater than or equal to 18

Exclusion Criteria:

* Problems other than biliary tract disease
study_population: Subjects presenting to Indiana University for treatment of biliary tract disease.
